title_as_printed: Experimental data on the reaction Br=Per+H2O in the presence of H2O-NaCl solutions (n/r small change in water content in the course of the run, Sat runs under NaCl-saturated conditions)

footnotes_as_printed.n/r: small change in water content in the course of the run

pressure_note: nominal sample pressure in kbar (internally heated Ar apparatus 2 and 4.2 kbar; piston-cylinder 4.2-15 kbar); uncertainty about +-200 bar, 4.2 kbar piston-cylinder runs possibly 220 bar high

value.what: H2O mole fraction of the NaCl-H2O fluid at the end of the run, after reaction toward brucite (Br) or periclase (Per); brackets of the brucite-periclase univariant equilibrium

value2.what: starting H2O mole fraction of the fluid

composition.other_species: binary NaCl-H2O fluid in equilibrium with brucite Mg(OH)2 and periclase MgO, X_NaCl = 1 - X_H2O (MgO solubility negligible); X(H2O) fin. is a reversal end point, not an equilibrium composition: the equilibrium fluid lies between the final compositions of opposite-direction runs (Fig. 3 caption: 'Opposing arrows show reversed equilibrated fluid compositions in equilibrium with brucite and periclase')

extra_unmapped: Phase grown (Br/Per direction of reaction; 'sat.' = NaCl-saturated)
conversion_needs: water activity is NOT tabulated here; it is derived by the authors from the brucite-periclase equilibrium via Eq. 3 (RT ln aH2O = dG0 - RT ln fH2O - P dVs); the bracketing directions give the equilibrium composition at each T and P
notes: Not a direct water-activity measurement: reversal brackets (starting and final fluid compositions, weight change after drying of punctured Pt capsules). Conditions far outside the usual database range (590-850 C, 2-15 kbar). Printed '0.30' for PB-112 X(H2O) st. kept. Entries are cross-over brackets: 'Per' means periclase grew (fluid too water-rich in the final state, aH2O above equilibrium), 'Br' brucite grew. Run PB-66 is printed at 765 C within a 735 C pair (PB-65 at 735 C); kept as printed. Extraction judged in scope because it is the only measured NaCl-H2O composition data underlying the H2O activities; the builder/PI may drop it.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: X(H2O) fin. is not offered as a point value of the equilibrium fluid; the table holds reversal brackets of a mineral equilibrium (p.205 Fig. 3 caption).
